preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the graph is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The number of edges of weight 1 in the graph is between 0 and the maximum possible number of edges, which is either n(n-1)/2 or 10^5, inclusive.
Each edge endpoint is a valid vertex index between 1 and n, inclusive.
No edge connects a vertex to itself.

preconditions.expression: No edge appears twice in the input
preconditions.description: Each edge is listed only once in the input.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer representing the weight of the minimum spanning tree.
If there are no edges of weight 1, the output is 0 because all edges have weight 0 and any spanning tree will have weight 0.
The weight of the minimum spanning tree is non-negative.
The weight of the minimum spanning tree is at most the number of edges of weight 1, because we can always include all edges of weight 1 in the spanning tree.
